text:
The most important rule in the engine. The AI never decides whether the potassium rose.

The physiology decides. Vitals, electrolytes, the ECG stage, all follow explicit rules written into the case. Give the wrong treatment and the numbers move the way biology says they must. Not the way a language model thinks they should.

The AI's job is to explain, not to invent. It reads what the engine produced and teaches the mechanism behind it.

That line matters more than anything else in the build. It is the difference between a tutor you can trust and a tool that will confidently make something up.

In a sandbox for medicine, the medicine has to be real. The story can flex. The physiology cannot.
